    ONCOR ELECTRIC DELIVERY COMPANY LLC AND LCRA TRANSMISSION
     SERVICES CORPORATION’S COMPLIANCE WITH SOAH ORDER NO. 19

       Pursuant to SOAH Order No. 19, the Administrative Law Judges (ALJs) ordered Applicants

to provide non-privileged information in response to JKK 10-03 by May 28, 2026. Applicants

produced the non-privileged documents responsive to JKK 10-03 on May 14, 2026 (Item No. 4622).

Therefore, Applicants have complied with SOAH Order No. 19.
